candidate_practices.name: Describe operations behind component names
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts specify representation changes, training interventions, or state updates alongside named components.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: operational descriptions let readers assess the proposed rationale without treating names as explanations.
candidate_practices.application: Replace a module inventory with what each component changes and the problem it targets; distinguish intended mechanism from demonstrated attribution.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not invent separate causal roles for inseparable components.

support.specific_example: Sparse voxels encode 3D structure; SDF supervision and rendering support direct mesh generation.
Two time-scale updates address critic estimation; inference-sample simulation addresses input mismatch.
Rotation redistributes outliers, permutation balances blocks, and another rotation smooths activations.
Decompose adds nodes; Analyze checks rationales; Rethink revises parents using child feedback.

contrasts.contrast: HydraLoRA mentions two inefficiency insights without describing them; this supports a diagnosis-to-proposal sequence, not a recoverable mechanism mapping.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Component interactions and evidence attributing outcomes to the stated mechanisms.

candidate_practices.name: Specify the information a new signal supplies
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts identify an information deficit and introduce a signal or representation addressing it.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: this makes novelty an information change rather than an auxiliary-input inventory.
candidate_practices.application: Write what existing inputs omit, what the added signal represents, and its operating condition.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not assert that a proxy captures missing information without supporting analysis.

support.specific_example: Indistinguishable inputs motivate testing for expert information absent from algorithmic data.
Generated self-supervised representations supply semantic conditioning without labels.
Response time complements binary choices particularly for strong preferences.
Student coverage history measures novelty as a complement to regret.

contrasts.contrast: FlipClass changes feedback direction by updating the teacher from student attention; the change need not introduce an external signal.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Signal validity, measurement assumptions, and whether the proposed information explains gains.

candidate_practices.name: Attach optimality to its exact comparison domain
candidate_practices.source_observation: Theoretical abstracts attach guarantees to parameter ranges, metrics, structural settings, or identification conditions.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: readers can distinguish a scoped resolution from unrestricted superiority.
candidate_practices.application: Place the regime and qualification in the same sentence as the guarantee; pair bounds only where their domains match.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: A qualitative result need not be rewritten as a rate or matching-bound claim.

support.specific_example: A construction matches lower bounds across rounds versus parallel work, up to logarithmic factors.
General MDP bounds add transient time B to bias span H.
The p-Wasserstein rate is distinguished from minimax optimality specifically at p=1.
Identification conditions precede valid-instrument discovery and causal-effect estimation.

contrasts.contrast: Hardness, a tractability condition, and reductions are presented as an initial step rather than a complete resolution.
Homogeneous and heterogeneous covariance settings organize the clustering guarantee; abstract-level optimality does not expose initialization conditions.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Formal assumptions, matching domains, hidden dependencies, and proof validity.

candidate_practices.name: Choose evidence axes from the promised capability
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts report distinct evidence for quality, control, scalability, or computational cost.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: aligned evidence makes separate promises independently assessable.
candidate_practices.application: For each headline property, select its corresponding result and preserve the comparator, workload, and resource qualifier.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not expand a narrowly scoped contribution into unsupported evaluation dimensions.

support.specific_example: VAR reports image metrics, scaling correlations, and zero-shot editing demonstrations.
Graph DiT separates distribution learning, property control, and an expert-informed application.
SDF-Sim reports hundreds of objects and 1.1 million nodes where mesh approaches exhaust memory.
STDE reports speed, memory, and a million-dimensional PDE workload on one A100.

contrasts.contrast: The quality–variation disentanglement claim accompanies FID results, but supplied evidence lacks variation measurements.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Comparable budgets, configurations, metric definitions, and application outcomes.

candidate_practices.name: Make the result depend on the revealing condition
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts foreground conditional, transient, or intervention-sensitive findings.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: the condition can be the lasting insight rather than a caveat to an average.
candidate_practices.application: Rewrite a universal improvement claim as a relationship between a named condition and the observed outcome.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not manufacture subgroup explanations from aggregate results.

support.specific_example: Generalization changes with task coverage, depth, training duration, and context-example count.
Label/order bias is separated from reported uniform responses after order randomization.
Place-cell width mediates a positional-resolution versus contextual-capacity tradeoff.
Task complexity determines collaboration mode; leading performance is limited to seven of ten benchmarks.

contrasts.contrast: A prediction-error assumption qualifies theoretical efficiency separately from application-based comparisons.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Condition definitions, transition thresholds, subgroup construction, and statistical support.

candidate_practices.name: Trace an intermediate representation to its consequence
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts connect intermediate representations to validity constraints or downstream computation.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: this explains why the representation matters beyond its name.
candidate_practices.application: State the representation, the invariant or interface it supplies, and the resulting operation.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not describe structural validity as empirical correctness or downstream success.

support.specific_example: Type-directed conjecture generation guarantees well-formedness, distinct from finding true conjectures.
Generated consistent views feed reconstruction and then arbitrary-view rendering.
Dynamic Gaussians become continuums whose rendered masks guide physical-property estimation.
Pfaffians enforce antisymmetry across stated spin and structural variations.

contrasts.contrast: RL-GPT explains a division of planning and execution responsibilities rather than a representation invariant.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Interface assumptions, failure propagation, and actual scope of structural guarantees.

candidate_practices.name: Define what a resource makes investigable
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts introduce task sets, measurement frameworks, or reusable development materials as contributions.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: the resource's research role can stand independently of a new algorithm.
candidate_practices.application: Specify the question enabled, the organizing dimensions, and the supplied artifact; separate construction from validation.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: A code-release sentence alone does not establish a benchmark or measurement contribution.

support.specific_example: YesBut distinguishes literal comic comprehension from deeper narrative reasoning.
Vision-model comparisons accompany data guidance and an open collection of models, tools, datasets, and recipes.
Reasoning boundaries organize quantification and optimization, with studies across models, tasks, and strategies.
A book-based policy-learning formulation is accompanied by Tic-Tac-Toe and Football benchmarks.

contrasts.contrast: The three-city benchmark accompanies an adaptation framework; the extraction does not establish independent benchmark validation.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Construction protocols, construct validity, coverage, accessibility, and reuse conditions.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Pair simplification with expanded recoverable quantities.
unusual_but_useful.application: Name the quadratic objective and recovered diffusion components.
unusual_but_useful.limit: Closed form is restricted to linear parametrization.

unusual_but_useful.practice: State exactly which objects have supervision.
unusual_but_useful.application: Explain dependency-tree guidance under target-only positional labels.
Connect stage errors to branching and distribution alignment.
State that the same correction module serves 11 LLMs.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Compare the replacement at its intended function.
unusual_but_useful.application: Present behavioral consensus against self-testing for correctness selection.
unusual_but_useful.limit: Consensus does not itself guarantee correctness.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Separate framework breadth from guarantee breadth.
unusual_but_useful.application: Keep representation-agnostic design and restricted convergence claims distinct.

unusual_but_useful.practice: State design criteria before the construction.
unusual_but_useful.application: Explain MetaLA through its three proposed conditions.
unusual_but_useful.limit: Their meaning of optimality needs checking.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Keep coherent outcomes from joint training.
unusual_but_useful.application: Report diffusion sampling and MCMC-free EBM outcomes separately.
unusual_but_useful.limit: Equilibrium is not evidence of training convergence.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Pair a mechanism with a control against excess.
unusual_but_useful.application: Explain scattering alongside its topology constraint.
unusual_but_useful.limit: Causal attribution is not established here.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Preserve resource ranges and best-case qualifiers.
unusual_but_useful.limit: Do not imply all extrema occur together.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Give a reinterpretation a computational consequence.
unusual_but_useful.application: Connect recursive denoising to parameter-fusion equivalence.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Replace stronger expressivity with countable targets.
unusual_but_useful.application: Name cycles through length r+2 and cactus homomorphisms.

discarded_generalizations.generalization: Every abstract needs a prior-method deficit and one remedy.
discarded_generalizations.reason: Some lead with a capability, experimental question, or critical examination; no uniform ORAL sequence is warranted.
Computational operations support a method description, not cognitive equivalence.

discarded_generalizations.generalization: A benchmark gain establishes practical user benefit.
discarded_generalizations.reason: Medical benchmarks and expert-informed molecular applications do not establish clinical or deployment outcomes.
